# Task 4e7a4606: Count horizontal bars into a 2×3 grid

When the input is a sparse grid with a uniform background and horizontal runs of colors 3 and 2:

1. Count each separate contiguous horizontal run (bar) of color 3 and of color 2. Count a run once regardless of its length; a run ends at a nonmatching cell or row boundary. Do not count individual colored cells.
2. Produce a 2×3 output: list all the 3-bars first, filling left-to-right across rows, then all the 2-bars, also left-to-right across rows.
3. Pad unused cells with background 0. In observed instances the input background is 0, 5, or 8, while the output padding is 0.

Evidence: demo 1 had four color-3 bars and one color-2 bar, output `[[3,3,3],[3,2,0]]`; demo 2 had two bars of each color, output `[[3,3,2],[2,0,0]]`.
